dog.description_text: Breeze is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Breeze, a five-year-old male, is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VqZhlkcEGjb5POZW0WQK-_eyLf6p2cdk/view?usp=drive_link Breeze is a very handsome guy. He has lived with other cats and gotten along well. Breeze benefits from slow introductions to new people and places while he adjusts. His foster says " He’s super playful and loves interactive toys, and treats are definitely the way to his heart." He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and had had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
